svg.title: Antigen presentation: the MHC class I pathway
svg.desc: Animated diagram of MHC class I antigen presentation. A viral protein made in the cytosol of an infected cell is degraded by the proteasome into peptides. TAP carries one peptide into the endoplasmic reticulum, where the peptide-loading complex (tapasin, calreticulin and ERp57) loads it onto MHC class I with beta-2-microglobulin. The loaded molecule passes through the Golgi apparatus to the cell surface, where the T cell receptor and CD8 of a CD8 T cell recognise it. Schematic, not to scale.
svg.text: loads a peptide onto MHC class I
